hints.add-groups: Append the selected regular users to groups without replacing existing memberships. The account owner is not a group member.
hints.authorize: Append policies to the selected subusers. Preserve direct grants, inherited policies and permission boundaries. Authorization does not change identity type.
hints.enable: Enable the selected subusers. Access still requires valid credentials and authorization; no permissions are added.
hints.disable: Disable the selected subusers. This changes identity status without deleting users or cloud resources.
hints.delete: Delete the selected subusers and their mock keys, grants and memberships, and revoke mock role sessions. Cloud resources remain owned by the account.

AccountAccess.accountIdHint: Immutable after creation. Also used as the stable suffix for subuser sign-in.
AccountAccess.loginHint: Start with a lowercase letter. Use lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens.
AccountAccess.primaryLoginHint: Primary usernames are unique across the platform.
AccountAccess.childLoginHint: Enter only the username, without an @ suffix.
AccountAccess.initialRoleHint: Without a role, the user can only view their own account. A selected role applies to the tenant's resources, not just resources created by this user.
AccountAccess.passwordHint: 14–128 bytes, no spaces. Include at least three of: uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols. Must be changed at first sign-in.
AccountAccess.tenantNotice: A new tenant has its own primary account and resource space. Creating it does not grant this session access to its resources.
AccountAccess.userNotice: Subusers share the primary account's resources and quotas. Deliver the initial password through a secure channel.
AccountAccess.policyAttachmentHint: Only current, unretracted direct USER attachments are shown here. Group inheritance, permission boundaries and final authorization are separate dimensions.
AccountAccess.noPolicyAttachmentsHint: No policies are directly attached. Default deny applies; inspect groups separately for inherited policies.
AccountAccess.policyRevisionChanged: The policy directory changed. Reselect the policy to avoid attaching an older revision.
AccountAccess.allPoliciesAttached: All currently attachable policies are already attached directly.
AccountAccess.policyDirectoryUnavailable: This identity cannot read a policy directory, so a new attachment cannot be created here.
AccountAccess.grantScopeHint: Roles apply to the primary account's resources, not only those created by this user. Permissions from different roles are combined.
AccountAccess.noRolesHint: No roles granted. This user can sign in to view their account, but cannot access protected resources.
AccountAccess.protectedHint: You cannot disable or reset the currently signed-in user through subuser management.
AccountAccess.disableHint: Disabling this user immediately revokes all their sessions and prevents sign-in.
AccountAccess.enableHint: Enabling allows sign-in with a valid password. Revoked sessions are not restored.
AccountAccess.resetHint: Resetting revokes all current sessions and requires a password change at next sign-in. It does not re-enable a disabled user.
AccountAccess.directoryHint: The primary identity owns the account's resources. Subusers have independent identities and access only what is granted.
AccountAccess.primaryProtectedHint: The primary identity owns the account. Subuser management cannot grant it permissions, disable it, reset its password or delete it.
AccountAccess.primaryCredentialsHint: Primary and subuser credentials are managed separately. This page cannot create primary account keys or reset its password. Use subusers for everyday work.
AccountAccess.ownerPermissionsHint: The primary identity has full access to resources owned by its account without subuser policy associations. This does not grant access to other tenants or platform-wide privileges.
AccountAccess.rootIdentityBoundaryHint: The account root identity is not a regular user. It cannot join groups or receive ordinary permission policies. Separate protected capabilities govern account recovery and other root operations.
AccountAccess.subuserOwnershipHint: This subuser belongs to the current account, which also owns resources the subuser creates. Administrator permissions do not make a subuser the primary identity.
AccountAccess.accessPermissionHint: Access methods control how a user signs in or calls APIs, not resource permissions. Access also requires valid credentials, an active identity and appropriate authorization.
AccountAccess.permissionSourceHint: Direct policies and group inheritance are shown separately. Removing a direct association does not remove the same policy inherited from a group. Administrator permissions do not change user type; effective access must evaluate all policies and boundaries.
AccountAccess.noUsersHint: Create subusers and grant permissions as needed.
AccountAccess.userPageHint: Search, filters and select-all cover regular users on this page only. The account owner is shown separately above.
AccountAccess.aliasSubtitle: A dedicated sign-in identifier for the primary account
AccountAccess.aliasHint: Subusers can use this alias instead of the primary account ID to sign in. It is not an email address, domain, or the primary account's username.
AccountAccess.aliasPending: Available after an alias is set
AccountAccess.aliasRule: 3–63 characters, starting with a lowercase letter. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; no trailing hyphen. Unique across the platform.
AccountAccess.aliasChangeHint: The old alias stops accepting sign-ins and stays reserved for this tenant. Existing sessions and resource ownership are unchanged; account-ID sign-in still works.
AccountAccess.aliasAdminHint: Contact your primary account administrator to configure or change this alias.
AccountAccess.tenantAdminHint: Only the platform bootstrap administrator can create tenants
AccountAccess.tenantScopeHint: Creating a tenant does not grant cross-tenant access
AccountAccess.permissionSubtitle: Four built-in, tenant-scoped roles are available
AccountAccess.defaultDenyHint: Access is denied unless granted. Resources created by subusers belong to the primary account and share its quotas. Tenants cannot access each other by default.
AccountAccess.permissionLimits: Platform roles follow the live IAM permission contract. Custom roles and policies are an isolated MOCK experience and do not change real permissions.

hints.trust: Choose who may request this identity. Trust does not grant access to resources.

trustHints.account: Only explicitly selected users in this preview tenant can be trusted. They also need an iam:assumeRole grant for this role. Cross-account and wildcard trust are not supported.
trustHints.service: Choose a registered synthetic workload. This simulates a service identity; it does not verify a real workload or create a service-linked role.
trustHints.provider: Choose an enabled synthetic identity provider. Session simulation also requires an enabled federation mapping to this role. No SAML/OIDC assertion is verified.

RoleWorkspace.durationHint: 15–720 minutes. This is the maximum duration for new sessions.
RoleWorkspace.consoleHint: Declares console-entry intent only. This preview never signs in as the role.
RoleWorkspace.boundaryHint: A boundary limits the maximum permissions. Both a grant and the boundary must allow a request; a boundary alone grants nothing. Uses the policy's current default version.
RoleWorkspace.boundaryChangeHint: Changing or removing a boundary can change effective permissions immediately, including existing preview role sessions. It does not add or detach grant policies.
RoleWorkspace.permissionsHint: Role sessions use these policies and the optional boundary, not the caller's own permissions.
RoleWorkspace.noPermissions: No policies attached · resource access is denied
RoleWorkspace.nameHint: 1–64 characters. The role name and carrier type cannot be changed after creation.
RoleWorkspace.invalidTrust: Choose an enabled provider, a registered service, or at least one current-tenant user.
RoleWorkspace.invalidName: Enter a name of 1–64 characters without angle brackets or control characters.
RoleWorkspace.duplicate: A role with this name already exists.
RoleWorkspace.invalidMetadata: Check tags and session duration. Use unique tag keys and a duration of 15–720 minutes.
RoleWorkspace.reviewHint: Creating trust does not grant callers permission to assume the role. Account users still need an explicit grant for iam:assumeRole.
RoleWorkspace.cancelHint: The unsaved trust, policies and role details will be discarded. Nothing has been created.
RoleWorkspace.noTrustChanges: No trusted identities have changed. Adjust your selection before reviewing.
RoleWorkspace.trustChangeHint: This trust replaces the previous trusted identities for new sessions. Existing sessions retain their expiry; revoke them separately if needed.
RoleWorkspace.settingsChangeHint: Changes apply to newly created sessions. Existing sessions are not extended or revoked. Console access here is MOCK metadata, not a sign-in action.
RoleWorkspace.policyChangeHint: The selected change affects this role's current and future preview sessions. Caller policies and the boundary are unchanged. Removing one grant does not remove equivalent grants from another policy.
RoleWorkspace.requiredAction: An account user also needs the following action/resource grant. The trust document above is not this grant.
RoleWorkspace.deleteImpact: Deleting the role makes its preview sessions unavailable. Policies and users are preserved. Remove federation references before deleting.
RoleWorkspace.sessionHint: Simulates a temporary role identity only. No token or credential is issued and your current login is unchanged. Resource checks use the role's current policies and boundary.
RoleWorkspace.sessionLimitHint: 15–{max} minutes. Expiry is fixed when the session is created.
RoleWorkspace.readyToCreate: Checks passed for this synthetic identity. They will run again when you create the session.
RoleWorkspace.assumptionDeniedHint: Check the trusted identity, caller's role-assumption policies and boundary. Unknown or restricted identities cannot create a session.

assumption.trustDenied: The role does not trust this identity
assumption.callerDenied: The caller is not authorized to assume this role

RoleWorkspace.noSessionsHint: Choose an identity and check its trust and permissions before creating a temporary session.
RoleWorkspace.revokeHint: This preview session will stop passing resource diagnostics immediately. Other sessions and the current login are unchanged.

IamWorkspace.entityUnavailableHint: This object is missing or not in the loaded directory. Return to the list to find it.

IamWorkspace.notConnectedHint: This operation is not available for live accounts. Use MOCK preview from the sign-in page to explore the complete workflow.
IamWorkspace.groupHint: Manage membership and preview permissions by team. Members inherit the group's simulated policies.
IamWorkspace.policyHint: Use predefined policies or write least-privilege rules, then associate them with users, groups or roles.
IamWorkspace.roleHint: Grant temporary roles to accounts, cloud services or external identities without distributing long-lived credentials.
IamWorkspace.providerHint: Manage SAML 2.0 and OIDC identity providers for role-based single sign-on.
IamWorkspace.federationHint: Map external identities to cloud roles. This preview sends no invitations and does not sync external directories.
IamWorkspace.keyHint: Use a dedicated subuser for API access. Keep at most 2 mock keys per user and disable old keys after rotation.
IamWorkspace.search: Search by name, ID or keyword
IamWorkspace.noResultsHint: Try another keyword or clear the filters.
IamWorkspace.emptyHint: Create the first record to configure access management.
IamWorkspace.name: Name
IamWorkspace.deleteHint: This removes the mock record and its configuration. Review dependencies before confirming.
IamWorkspace.permissionUsesHint: These associations can contribute candidate permissions to users, groups or roles. Explicit denies, permission boundaries and other applicable rules still constrain effective access.
IamWorkspace.noPermissionUses: This policy is not associated as a permission policy.
IamWorkspace.noBoundaryUses: This policy is not used as a permission boundary.
IamWorkspace.noSelection: Nothing selected; access is denied by default.
IamWorkspace.allAccountResources: All applicable resources in this account
IamWorkspace.policyInterpretation: The summary and JSON use the same document. This MOCK view does not change your signed-in identity or real resource permissions.
IamWorkspace.descriptionOnly: Updates the description only. No new policy version or permission change.
IamWorkspace.policyNameImmutable: A policy name cannot change after creation. Copy it to create a policy with a new name.
IamWorkspace.newVersionImpact: Saving changed content creates and activates a new version for {count} directly associated identities and their group members. Unchanged content adds no version.
IamWorkspace.versionHistoryHint: {count}/{limit} saved versions. Inspecting history changes nothing; the default version cannot be deleted.
IamWorkspace.inspectVersionHint: Read-only inspection. The default version and associations stay unchanged.
IamWorkspace.rollbackImpact: Switching moves {count} policy usage relationships to the target version, including permission attachments and permission boundaries. Review both documents before confirming. This affects MOCK data only.
IamWorkspace.deleteVersionHint: Deletes nondefault version v{version}; it can no longer be restored. Effective permissions and associations stay unchanged.
IamWorkspace.actionHint: Separate actions with commas, for example logs:search, logs:list
IamWorkspace.resourceHint: Separate resources with commas; * means all resources.
IamWorkspace.policyFormat: Matrix MOCK format: version 1, with effect, action and resource in each statement. Other fields produce an error and are never silently ignored.
IamWorkspace.systemReadOnly: Predefined policies are read-only. Copy one to customize it.
IamWorkspace.highPrivilege: Includes permission-management actions. Review resources, conditions and associated identities; denies and boundaries still limit effective access.
IamWorkspace.serviceNoConsole: Service roles are for workloads and cannot sign into the console.
IamWorkspace.roleSecurity: MOCK · No real STS credentials or login changes
IamWorkspace.metadataHint: Use EntityDescriptor XML for SAML or JWKS JSON with a keys array for OIDC. Only local format is validated; no external URL is contacted.
IamWorkspace.subject: External subject
IamWorkspace.ssoHint: Map enterprise identities to existing cloud users. Enabling this preview does not change the actual sign-in flow.
IamWorkspace.ssoFlow: Enterprise IdP → authentication → Matrix user → user permissions
IamWorkspace.ssoMissing: Create an identity provider before configuring SSO.
IamWorkspace.keyWarning: This is a mock key and cannot authenticate any API. The secret is displayed only in this window and is discarded on close.
IamWorkspace.keyAcknowledge: I understand this is a mock key and have saved the preview information I need
IamWorkspace.keyPrimary: Create a subuser first. Routine API keys are not created for the primary account.
IamWorkspace.noKeyLogs: No access history. Mock keys never call real APIs.
IamWorkspace.changeStateHint: Confirm the target. This change affects only the current preview data.
IamWorkspace.requireComplexity: Require upper/lowercase letters, numbers and symbols
IamWorkspace.securityMock: These settings are previews only. They do not activate MFA, change password enforcement or revoke sessions.
IamWorkspace.overviewHint: Manage identities, permissions and credentials centrally. Start with least privilege and a clear boundary for every access.
IamWorkspace.eventHistoryHint: The latest 100 operations in this preview session, not a real security audit trail.
IamWorkspace.highPoliciesHint: Policies whose current default version includes permission-management actions, for review. This is not an effective-access assessment.
IamWorkspace.reviewPrivilegeHint: Counts users with direct or group-derived high-privilege policies once, plus tenant administrators. This does not describe effective access.
IamWorkspace.reportHint: Exports the current preview state only, never passwords or secrets.
IamWorkspace.guideGroupsHint: {count} groups have both members and policies. Review whether their grants are necessary.
IamWorkspace.guideKeysHint: {count} enabled mock keys. Create subuser keys only when needed and disable unused keys.
IamWorkspace.guideProtectionSaved: Mock login protection is configured. Real MFA is not activated.
IamWorkspace.guideProtectionUnset: Mock login protection is not configured. This preview cannot activate real MFA.

errors.invalid: Check input format, referenced objects and numeric ranges.
errors.duplicate: This name already exists. Choose a different name.
errors.referenced: This object is still referenced. Remove its associations before deleting.
errors.disableFirst: Disable the key before deleting it.
errors.systemPolicy: Predefined policies cannot be modified or deleted.
errors.unsupportedPolicy: Unsupported policy fields or condition keys. The draft is unchanged; restrictions are never discarded.
errors.versionLimit: A policy can retain 5 versions. Inspect and delete a nondefault version in version history before saving new content.
errors.defaultVersion: The default version cannot be deleted. Review and switch to another version first.
errors.immutablePolicyName: Policy names cannot change after creation. Copy this policy to create a new one.
errors.notFound: This record no longer exists. Refresh and retry.
errors.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.unavailable: The operation could not be completed. Please retry.
errors.unknownAction: An action or wildcard is not in the supported catalog.
errors.invalidResource: Resource format/type does not match the actions. Account-level actions require all resources; do not mix * and specific scopes.
errors.tenantResource: Resources must belong to this tenant; wildcards cannot grant cross-tenant access.
errors.invalidCondition: Check resource tags, IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs and UTC time bounds. Conditions cannot be empty; account-level actions do not support resource tags.
errors.invalidTrust: Invalid trust: choose current-tenant users, a registered service or an enabled provider.
errors.trustDenied: Trust check failed. No session was created.
errors.callerDenied: The caller's policies or boundary do not allow role assumption. No session was created.
errors.sessionLimit: There are 100 active preview sessions. Revoke unused sessions first.
errors.staleUsers: Selected users changed. Nothing was committed. Close this dialog, refresh and select again.
errors.ineligibleUsers: The selection includes an ineligible user. Nothing was committed. Check identity types, status and permissions.
errors.associationLimit: Appending these associations would exceed 30 for a user. Nothing was committed. Reduce the selection.

IamWorkspace.enterpriseStart: Connect enterprise identities and import your team
IamWorkspace.enterpriseHint: Connect WeCom and import members from the authorized visibility scope as subusers. Member provisioning and SSO are separate configurations.
IamWorkspace.enterpriseFlow: Connect enterprise → set visible scope → import members → assign permissions
IamWorkspace.enterpriseMock: This demo does not scan QR codes, install WeCom apps, connect directories or send invitations. Use mock enterprise information only.
IamWorkspace.importHint: Import creates mock users in this preview session with no permissions. Assign access afterward through users or groups.

PolicyWorkspace.searchPolicies: Search policy names, descriptions or tags
PolicyWorkspace.categoryHint: Permission levels classify preset policies, not read/write capabilities or tag conditions. Inspect the policy for its authorization scope.
PolicyWorkspace.keptDirect: {user} still has this policy through a direct attachment.
PolicyWorkspace.batchLimit: Select up to 30 policies; filters and pagination preserve selection.

presetDescriptions.policy-admin: Administer all registered services and access permissions in this tenant.
presetDescriptions.policy-read: Read and list cloud resources without permission to change them.
presetDescriptions.policy-delivery: Deploy and manage applications and run delivery pipelines.
presetDescriptions.policy-audit: Read audit events and audit listings.

PolicyWorkspace.analyzerHint: Syntax checks and risk guidance, not proof of authorization. Statement indices in JSON paths start at 0.
PolicyWorkspace.analysisPending: Configure actions to check this policy. Drafts are never saved automatically.
PolicyWorkspace.analysisPassed: The document passes syntax checks for the supported subset.
PolicyWorkspace.permissionManagement: Includes permission-management actions. Confirm the need to create identities, grant access or assume roles.
PolicyWorkspace.unrestrictedWrite: Write or permission-management actions apply to all relevant resources in this tenant. Consider separate resource-scoped statements.
PolicyWorkspace.wildcardAction: An action wildcard can include actions registered in the future. Consider an explicit action list.
PolicyWorkspace.duplicateStatement: This duplicates an earlier statement. Consider merging them to simplify review.
PolicyWorkspace.tagMethodHint: Every statement requires resource-tag conditions and operations that support them. All tags must match. Unsupported operations never receive unrestricted access automatically. Request tags are not supported by the current model.
PolicyWorkspace.associationReviewHint: Only confirmation updates this MOCK session. Removing one association does not remove all of a user's access.
PolicyWorkspace.batchHint: Append these policies to the selected identities. Existing policies, group memberships and boundaries remain unchanged.
PolicyWorkspace.remainingHint: These are other association paths for the same policy. Actual access still depends on other policies and conditions.
PolicyWorkspace.noImpact: No current associations or boundary references.
PolicyWorkspace.impactHint: References to the default version, including group members and boundaries. This is not an effective-permission report.
PolicyWorkspace.noStatementChanges: Statements are equivalent in structure; only ordering, duplicates or metadata may differ.
PolicyWorkspace.diffHint: A resource or condition change shows both the old and new statement. Text removal does not prove that access has been revoked.
PolicyWorkspace.inventoryHint: Selecting fills the scope without granting access. You may also manually define a future resource in this tenant.
PolicyWorkspace.summaryCount: {services, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} · {statements, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}
PolicyWorkspace.operationRuleCount: {actions, plural, one {# operation} other {# operations}} · from {rules, plural, one {# independent statement} other {# independent statements}}
PolicyWorkspace.branchHint: An operation may appear in several statements. Each statement matches its own resources and conditions independently; conditions are not combined across statements.
PolicyWorkspace.catalogExpansion: Wildcards are expanded against currently registered capabilities for reading only. Newly registered operations may also be covered; the original wildcard rules remain unchanged.
PolicyWorkspace.selectActionsFirst: Select operations before configuring their supported resource scopes and conditions.
PolicyWorkspace.incompatibleConditions: Some selected operations do not support an existing condition. The draft is retained. Remove the incompatible condition or operation; access is never broadened automatically.

PolicyWizard.resourceTagsRequired: Enable resource-tag restrictions and enter tags for every statement. Switch to visual editing if tag restrictions are not needed.

visual.title: Policy generator
visual.description: Select services, actions, resources and conditions to generate a policy.

json.title: Policy syntax
json.description: Write policy JSON and check its syntax and authorization scope.

tags.title: Tag-based authorization
tags.description: Scope access by resource tags, then attach the policy to identities.

features.title: Product features or project permissions
features.description: Choose product features to generate a policy. Project permissions are not connected yet.

PolicyWizard.featureScopeHint: No permissions are selected by default. Selected features apply to all relevant resources in this tenant. Use the policy generator for resource or tag restrictions. Project permissions are not connected yet.
PolicyWizard.featureUnavailable: This draft contains Deny, conditions, specific resources or wildcards and cannot be converted to feature selection without changing its meaning. Continue with visual or JSON editing.

hints.document: Combine authorization statements, apply a template or edit JSON. Nothing is saved at this step.
hints.details: Set metadata and optionally associate identities. No new permissions are selected by default.
hints.review: Review the document, associations and version impact before saving them together.

PolicyWizard.chooseTemplate: Choose a predefined or custom policy
PolicyWizard.replaceTemplateHint: Use the default version of {name} to replace all statements. The name, tags and selected associations stay unchanged. The source policy will not change.
PolicyWizard.visualUnavailable: This JSON cannot be represented losslessly in the visual form. Correct it in JSON; no fields or statements will be discarded.
PolicyWizard.actionsHint: One action per line, for example logs:search. At least one action is required.
PolicyWizard.resourcesHint: One resource scope per line. * means all applicable resources within the current tenant.
PolicyWizard.tagsHint: Tags organize policies. They are not resource-tag conditions and do not change access.
PolicyWizard.nameHint: Up to 64 characters. The name cannot change after creation.
PolicyWizard.invalidName: Enter a policy name of 1–64 characters, without control characters or angle brackets.
PolicyWizard.targetsHint: These associations are updated together. When editing, deselection removes an existing association, not permissions received from other policies or groups.
PolicyWizard.noTargetsHint: The policy will be saved without granting access to any new identity. You can associate it later.
PolicyWizard.targetLimit: Up to 30 identities per category. Search and category changes preserve selection.
PolicyWizard.grantImpact: Update policy associations for {count} selected identities. Group changes affect members; existing associations not retained during editing will be removed.
PolicyWizard.mockHint: MOCK · Page-local draft, no real permission changes
PolicyWizard.savedHint: {name} is saved in the current MOCK session.
PolicyWizard.savedScope: The policy, tags and selected associations were saved together. No real cloud permissions or charges are created.
PolicyWizard.newRevision: Create and activate v{version}. All retained associations will use the new version.
PolicyWizard.metadataOnly: The document is unchanged. Save metadata and association changes without creating a revision.
PolicyWizard.historyFull: The five-version limit is reached. Select a nondefault version to replace; it is removed only if the entire save succeeds.
PolicyWizard.replacementHint: Saving removes v{version}; it will no longer be available for rollback. The current default will not be deleted.
PolicyWizard.cancelHint: Leaving discards this policy draft. It does not create or change a policy or its associations.

PolicyRules.switchHint: This clears this statement’s actions and resource scope. Conditions and other statements remain. Review the new scope.
PolicyRules.allResources: All applicable resources in this tenant
PolicyRules.accountLevel: Includes account-level actions: choose all applicable resources; resource-tag conditions are unsupported.
PolicyRules.resourceHint: Region may be *. A trailing * matches an ID prefix. Every scope remains inside the current tenant.
PolicyRules.conditionsHint: All condition types must match. Any IP range may match; every tag must match.
PolicyRules.ipHint: One IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR per line, up to 10. Example: 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.
PolicyRules.resourceTags: Resource must have all these tags
PolicyRules.emptyTags: Add at least one resource-tag condition. These are not the policy’s metadata tags.

actionDescriptions.regions:readNode: Read the status of a compute node.
actionDescriptions.regions:maintainNode: Change maintenance state for a node.

AccessSimulator.exampleHint: Fills the request only. No policies or memberships change; results use your current preview data.

path.label: Resource path scope
path.hint: Compare production/payment with archive/payment. Both have production tags, but this user's grant matches only the production/ path.

duplicate.label: Direct and inherited grants
duplicate.hint: Inspect the same policy arriving directly and through a group. Removing just one grant source may leave another applicable source.

tags.label: Resource-tag authorization
tags.hint: This resource has production tags despite its archive/ name. Compare it with a staging topic; policy metadata tags do not control access.

deny.label: Matching explicit deny
deny.hint: Inspect the production deployment guard, then compare a staging deployment. A deny matters only when its action, resource and conditions match.

boundary.label: Permission boundary
boundary.hint: The group grants application operations, but this user's boundary excludes deletion. Compare the same resource's deployment operation.

ungranted.label: Console access without grants
ungranted.hint: The user has console access enabled in MOCK, but no resource grants. Login method and policy permissions are independent.

AccessSimulator.disabledUser: This user is disabled. You may inspect their policies, but this simulation does not validate login or credentials.
AccessSimulator.notEvaluated: Not evaluated: account/user availability, credentials, real sessions and product-side enforcement. A policy allow is not proof that a real request will succeed.
AccessSimulator.sessionScope: This diagnostic also checks the selected MOCK session's expiry, revocation and role/caller existence. It does not validate real STS credentials or inherit the caller's user policies.
AccessSimulator.scope: Simulates current-tenant user grants or a preview role session, intersected with its boundary. No real resources, external identity verification or backend authorization. Cross-account, resource policies and role chaining are unsupported.
AccessSimulator.contextHint: Used for conditions only. Leave blank to test missing-context behavior.
AccessSimulator.evidenceCount: {count} evaluation records, including the current default version and grant source.
AccessSimulator.beforeRun: Choose a user or preview role session, action and test resource, then run the simulation. No real resources will be read or changed.
AccessSimulator.noUsersHint: Create a preview user before checking their policy grants.
AccessSimulator.noGrantsHint: This user has no direct policies or inherited group policies. Access is denied by default.

explanations.allow: Grant policies allow this request, and a configured boundary must also allow it. No matching deny or missing decision context was found. Applies only to this simulation.
explanations.explicitDeny: An explicit deny matched. Other allow statements cannot override it.
explanations.implicitDeny: Grant policies or the configured boundary did not allow this action, resource and context. Inspect the evidence for each source.
explanations.indeterminate: Condition context or a readable policy is missing. This result cannot be treated as permission to access a resource.
explanations.invalidRequest: Check that the user, action and test resource are within the supported simulation scope.

errors.unknownIdentity: This user could not be found. Choose a user in the current tenant.
errors.unknownResource: The test resource is missing or its reference is invalid.
errors.crossTenant: The resource belongs to a different tenant. Cross-tenant access cannot be simulated.
errors.unknownAction: The action is not in the supported Matrix action catalog.
errors.actionResourceMismatch: The selected resource type is not supported by this action.
errors.requiresRoleTrust: Assuming a role also requires trust-policy and session checks. A user-policy simulation cannot determine this.
errors.expiredSession: The session has expired. Changing request time cannot extend its lifetime.
errors.revokedSession: This preview session has been revoked.
errors.unavailableSession: The session, role or original caller is unavailable.

AccessSimulator.boundaryResult: Boundary {name}: {decision}. Grant policies must also allow the request.
